effect: When a draft record is requested in the reply and no file, the draft is delivered inline in the house shape with its standing and number qualifications beside it, and nothing is written.

semantic.criterion: The reply contains an inline ADR with Date, explicit Status and Context/Decision/Consequences. It preserves the proposal to allow hives on plots 22 and 23 only, annual insurance, and the concern about stings near children’s plots. No sentence cap or invented costs apply.
The draft explicitly says Status: Proposed; its title and prose do not imply approval or that hives are allowed now.

Beside the draft, the reply states in one sentence that the standing is a proposal awaiting the members' vote at the annual general meeting, and, if the draft carries a number, states in one sentence that the number is provisional and to be rechecked before the record is filed. A reply that presents the draft without the standing sentence fails.
The reply does not say a file was written, saved or created, and offers no file path as the record's location.

The draft and the reply state nothing the minutes do not: no number of hives beyond the applicant's two, no insurer, no fee, no outcome of the vote. Date identifies the dated minutes as the earliest available durable record and uses their date, rather than the later ADR-writing date. Source-supported authority is allowed.
The reply asks the user nothing at all.
Whether write-for-humans was loaded for the prose, read off inspection.json (skillReads["write-for-humans"].body or .invoked true); recorded for the shared-reference question, never counts.

Whether docs/writing-guidance.md was read whole, read off inspection.json (sourceReads["docs/writing-guidance.md"].body true, through the skill-local copy or the canonical path); recorded, never counts.

Date identifies the source minutes and uses their date as the earliest available dated durable record. A later ADR-writing date does not replace that known source date; historical meanings are not relabeled as implementation or acceptance dates without evidence.
